interface.name: kos_surface_shape_manager_v1
interface.description: Creates independent shape declarations for regions inside a wl_surface. Coordinates and radius use surface-local logical units.

request.name: commit
request.description: Seal pending state for every v8 shape belonging to this surface. The sealed snapshot is applied on the next wl_surface.commit, together with its buffer. Subsequent setters affect the next transaction. New shapes start disabled. Destroy retires the object; its committed drawing state is removed by the next manager commit and wl_surface.commit. Surface destruction always releases all state immediately. Clients publish the full window batch during Qt Quick polish, then request a frame; commit does not itself commit the wl_surface. A v8 surface derives its capture region exclusively from these shapes, including an empty set. Independent blur-region requests are ignored. v1-v7 resources retain their historical immediate setter semantics.

request.name: set_capture_geometry

description.summary: fixed backdrop capture separate from the visible outline

request.description: Surface-local logical rectangle containing this shape throughout its animation. The compositor uses it for background capture and alignment; set_geometry still controls the visible outline, refraction and rim. A zero width or height restores the geometry-based capture policy. Clients must check the negotiated version before sending this request.

request.name: set_material_opacity

description.summary: opacity of the complete compositor glass finish

request.description: Opacity in the range 0..1, applied to the final premultiplied glass composite, including blur, refraction, highlights, scrim and noise. Geometry and capture allocation are unaffected. The default is 1. Clients must check the negotiated version before sending this request.

request.name: set_reveal
request.description: enabled selects a persistent reveal controller. Geometry remains the final rectangle and capture bounds remain fixed. opened selects the target endpoint; duration is milliseconds (clamped to 1..2000). The compositor interpolates the visible SDF outline and the whole surface content. Disabling restores ordinary rendering. Serial is echoed on completion so interrupted transitions can discard stale events.

request.name: set_material

description.summary: explicit optical effect and material profile

request.description: Profiles scale optical effects only; neither blur nor tint nor opacity changes implicitly. Frosted bypasses liquid optics, retaining the same outline, Gaussian backdrop, tint and independent readability scrim.

request.name: set_blur_sigma
request.description: Sigma in surface-local logical pixels, clamped to 0..32. Zero samples the original backdrop. This overrides set_blur without changing tint, readability or complete-effect opacity. No legacy finetune multiplier.

request.name: set_tint

description.summary: color mixing independent of backdrop filtering

request.description: Non-premultiplied RGB and opacity in 0..1. Fixed mixes the supplied color with the filtered backdrop; graphite/pearl use named colors. No mode blends the original sharp backdrop into the filtered result. Readability uses set_scrim with decay restricted to 0..1 on v8; legacy values above 1 are decoded only for v1-v7 resources. set_material_opacity remains the fade of the complete effect.
